transcript.content: Due to a recent decline in business sales, I have significant anxiety and stress; I tend to catastrophize the problem, believing the decline will continue throughout the year, and it has caused sleep disturbance and decreased appetite. I feel extremely hopeless, and have even thought about ending my life and leaving this world.

[Crisis Intervention] I take your safety very seriously. A high-risk signal has been detected; please immediately call the psychological assistance hotline: 400-161-9995 or seek emergency medical help.

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry about business decline and catastrophic thinking
antecedent: Sees a decline in the sales report
Thinking of the uncertainty of the economic environment
When alone, repeatedly recalls the worst-case scenario
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizes a short-term decline into a long-term trend, and uses 'expecting the worst' to gain a sense of control (control fallacy/catastrophizing)
target_behavior.function: Seeks a sense of safety and control by rehearsing the worst-case scenario in uncertain situations (to avoid unexpected blows)
target_behavior.consequence: Escalating anxiety, insomnia and decreased appetite, impaired attention and decision-making, further affecting work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (reduced communication with friends and family)
antecedent: Others offer suggestions or ask about recent circumstances
Worries about being seen as 'always complaining' or 'the other party does not understand'
target_behavior.core_reason: Attributes the experience of 'being misunderstood' to others; worries about exposing vulnerability and helplessness
target_behavior.function: Avoids interactions that might bring disappointment or being ignored, temporarily reducing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Sources of support decrease, feelings of isolation intensify, negative emotions persist and worsen
